description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with Git repositories, including retrieving repository info, converting URLs, sanitizing URLs, extracting repository names, checking Git installation, searching commits, getting commit info, working state, status, branch info, and file changes. It also includes functions for detecting base branches and comparing branches, primarily used within a VSCode extension context.

methods.name: getGitRepositoryInfo
methods.description: Extracts git repository information from the specified workspace root, including URL, repository name, and default branch.

methods.name: convertGitUrlToHttps
methods.description: Converts various git URL formats to HTTPS format for telemetry and standardization.

methods.name: sanitizeGitUrl
methods.description: Removes sensitive information like tokens from a git URL.

methods.name: extractRepositoryName
methods.description: Extracts the repository name from a git URL.

methods.name: getWorkspaceGitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves git info for the current VSCode workspace.

methods.name: checkGitRepo
methods.description: Checks if the specified directory is a git repository.

methods.name: checkGitInstalled
methods.description: Checks if Git is installed on the system.

methods.name: searchCommits
methods.description: Searches for commits matching a query within a repository.

methods.name: getCommitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific commit.

methods.name: getWorkingState
methods.description: Gets the current working state of the repository, including uncommitted changes.

methods.name: getGitStatus
methods.description: Provides the status of the repository with optional file limit.

methods.name: getCurrentBranch
methods.description: Gets the current branch name.

methods.name: detectBaseBranch
methods.description: Detects the base branch (main/master/develop) from remote or local branches.

methods.name: hasUncommittedChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are uncommitted changes.

methods.name: getUncommittedDiff
methods.description: Gets the diff of uncommitted changes.

methods.name: getUncommittedFiles
methods.description: Lists uncommitted files with their status.

methods.name: getBranchDiff
methods.description: Gets the diff between current branch and a specified base branch.

methods.name: getBranchFilesChanged
methods.description: Lists files changed between current branch and a specified base branch.

methods.name: isOnBaseBranch
methods.description: Checks if the current branch is a base branch.

methods.name: getCommitCountFromBase
methods.description: Counts commits ahead of a specified base branch.
